note: Cuba: tourist card bought from the airline or online, no application
Ghana: free but mandatory ETA for previously visa-exempt and non-ECOWAS/AES African nationals
Seychelles: free visitor permit on arrival for every nationality, but the online ES-Pass travel authorisation (paid) is mandatory before travel
Turkmenistan e-visa (evisa.migration.gov.tm) since 2026-10-01; no invitation letter for tourists
Chad: evisa.td is the sole channel for visas since 2026-05-11 (visas for US citizens suspended)
Liberia e-visa on arrival: online approval, visa issued at Roberts International Airport
Australia Visitor visa (subclass 600): case-officer assessment with proof of funds and home ties, from AUD 250; a full visa, not a simple e-visa. ETA/eVisitor passports unaffected
Korea C-3-9 tourist visa is applied for at an embassy or visa centre with financial documents; the e-visa is not open to ordinary individual tourists
